about.en: Innovent Biologics, Inc. is a Chinese biopharmaceutical company that discovers, develops and commercialises monoclonal antibodies, bispecifics and other biologics for oncology, cardiovascular and metabolic, autoimmune and ophthalmic disease, including the PD-1 antibody sintilimab. Its shares trade on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange as 1801, and derivative markets quote the same equity under the INNOVENT ticker.
